plaster.label: plaster wall
plaster.method: image quilting (Efros-Freeman), block 36px, overlap 10px, min-cut seams, light gradient flattened (sigma 30), made wrap-around warmed 7% to match the lamp-lit room

plaster_ceiling.label: ceiling (plaster pieces, lightened)
plaster_ceiling.method: image quilting (Efros-Freeman), block 36px, overlap 10px, min-cut seams, light gradient flattened (sigma 30), made wrap-around lightened + warmed. The ceiling was never filmed; this is wall plaster placed overhead

floor.label: dark wood floor
floor.method: image quilting (Efros-Freeman), block 44px, overlap 12px, min-cut seams, light gradient flattened (sigma 40), made wrap-around brightened 30% (the frame is exposed for the window)

trim.label: dark window/door trim
trim.method: image quilting (Efros-Freeman), block 14px, overlap 4px, min-cut seams, light gradient flattened (sigma 0), made wrap-around

redwood.label: red wood (nightstand / bed frame)
redwood.method: image quilting (Efros-Freeman), block 24px, overlap 8px, min-cut seams, light gradient flattened (sigma 0), made wrap-around

fabric.label: cream headboard fabric
fabric.method: image quilting (Efros-Freeman), block 12px, overlap 4px, min-cut seams, light gradient flattened (sigma 0), made wrap-around

linen.label: white bedding / pillows
linen.method: image quilting (Efros-Freeman), block 28px, overlap 8px, min-cut seams, light gradient flattened (sigma 20), made wrap-around

lamp.label: real lamp + plant
lamp.method: GrabCut cut-out of the real pixels (6 iterations), edge feathered 1 px; placed as an upright billboard
